description: production-engineering-standards: block an edit outside the active Implementation Plan's Files in Scope.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/plan_scope_guard.py"; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/plan_scope_guard.py"; else echo 'production-engineering-standards: Python not found; the plan scope guard is off and the edit is allowed.' >&2; exit 1; fi
